item.title: My Contribution Featured in Hacker Journal N.275
How I Solved the Unlock Security OSINT Challenge
item.description: Inspired by the many challenges by Gary Ruddell (LinkedIn Profile), Unlock Security (LinkedIn Profile) has introduced a rather unique OSINT challenge: no contextual information and just a single blurry photo with few visible details. 🔎 The Challenge: Can you determine the location where this photo was taken? Step 1: Using Face Recognition To begin, I used facecheck.id, an online face recognition tool, to identify if the person in the photo appears on any public platform or social media.
